ListPreference.app:summary: Automatic starts the full desktop installed in the Linux environment (MATE, Xfce, LXQt...) or the built-in Openbox desktop. A session that cannot start falls back to Openbox. Applies when the desktop next starts.

ListPreference.app:title: Desktop resolution
ListPreference.app:summary: Retina renders at the real resolution of your screen with everything scaled 2x - crisp text at the usual size. Higher resolutions cost more CPU while windows change; the live rate is shown on the desktop (LIVE n.n fps). Applies when the desktop next starts (Restart desktop now).

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Show desktop diagnostics
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: The frame-rate / input status lines at the top left of the desktop. Off keeps the desktop clean; they still appear by themselves if the picture stops updating.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Share clipboard with the desktop
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Copy on the tablet, paste in Linux apps - and the other way round.

Preference.app:title: Restart desktop now
Preference.app:summary: Applies the capture quality immediately. Restarting ends the X session, so open windows are lost - the Linux terminal is not affected.

ListPreference.app:title: Mouse / trackpad scroll speed
ListPreference.app:summary: How far one wheel notch or two-finger flick scrolls. Trackpad deltas are fractional, so the pane accumulates the remainder and emits whole scroll steps - a slow crawl still moves exactly.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Trackpad: two-finger swipe scrolls
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: For keyboard-cover trackpads (Android 13 and older) that report a two-finger swipe as one moving contact. Turn off only if moving ONE finger on your trackpad scrolls instead of moving the pointer.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Natural scrolling (mouse / trackpad)
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: On (default): content follows the fingers / wheel, like a touchscreen. Off: classic wheel direction. Applies to the mouse, the trackpad and the on-screen two-finger gesture alike.

EditTextPreference.app:summary: Alpine: mirror base URL. Any distro: paste a full .tar.gz/.tar.xz rootfs URL to use a self-hosted image.
